# LPU Events

> Central discovery hub for student events, workshops, technical competitions, cultural fests, clubs, and campus life at Lovely Professional University.

## Links

- [Events Directory](https://lpuevents.live/): Explore upcoming and ongoing campus events.
- [About](https://lpuevents.live/?page=about): About the LPU Events discovery platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://lpuevents.live/?page=privacy): User privacy and data protection guidelines.
- [Terms of Service](https://lpuevents.live/?page=terms): Terms and conditions for platform usage.
- [Contact Us](https://lpuevents.live/?page=contact): Contact the LPU Events team.
